verdict.rationale: Vanta markets a dedicated Access Reviews product with pre-built content and guided workflows (vanta-docs-21) that claims to cut review time by up to 90% (vanta-docs-37), and it connects to identity providers and productivity tools (vanta-docs-26). However, the evidence is thin marketing copy and does not show the specific mechanics the story asks for. Missing for 10: evidence of periodic/scheduled review campaigns, reviews spanning connected apps, in-app reviewer sign-off, the completed review artifact landing in the evidence library, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
